answer: Require each agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn rewards, then use a randomly timed beacon to select a small set of agents for audits. Auditors compare signed work histories and shared control signals; if a cluster proves to be one operator posing as many identities, slash its stakes and cancel its rewards. Honest agents recover their deposits, while a sybil attacker must lock up capital for every identity and risks losing it all. The nectar of cheap, instant identities is blunted: each fake must carry a real, forfeitable cost, not merely a pearl of reputation.
